agent_explanation: Momentum drifts monotonically because leapfrog substepping is insufficient for the close, high-mass pair (bodies 1 and 2) under high G. With dt=0.00706 only 3 substeps are used while bodies 1-2 approach from 1.43 to 1.18 distance with speeds ~4.7, leading to integration error accumulation in total momentum (65.961 -> 65.879) exceeding 0.1% tolerance. Halving dt removes the violation, confirming accuracy issue rather than explicit force asymmetry.
